note: Every network endpoint AgentOS code may contact, classed per SPEC.md §2. Checked by tools/depaudit.py (A9). Adding an endpoint is a reviewed change: inherent and commodity endpoints must be justified against §2; optional ones must be removable (DEP-3). AgentOS-operated endpoints are forbidden (DEP-2) and cannot be declared.

endpoints.dependency: Codex CLI provider worker (CAP-11, optional per DEP-3): OpenAI's device sign-in page. The worker's CLI reaches it only through the egress sign-in route, and the owner opens it on their phone to enter the code (ONB-3 step 6, #1264).

Gmail API (CLK-9, D-150; optional per DEP-3): the mail clerk's declared calls on the owner's Gmail account (broker/clerk/inbox/gmail.go, #2851). Only an owner who connects Gmail reaches it; IMAP and SMTP serve any other provider.

Google's OAuth token endpoint (D-150; optional per DEP-3): the mail clerk redeems its sealed Gmail refresh grant there (broker/clerk/inbox/gmail.go, #2851). Only an owner who connects Gmail reaches it.

Google's OAuth consent page (D-150; optional per DEP-3): the address a Gmail sign-in gives the owner to open on their own phone (broker/clerk/inbox/gmailauth.go, #2852). The box never dials it; only an owner who connects Gmail sees it.

Google's Cloud console (D-150; optional per DEP-3): the registration steps on the owner page's Gmail Connect step link there, to open on the owner's own device (broker/localui/connect.go, #2853). The box never dials it; only an owner who connects Gmail sees it.
